purpose: Separate perception, selection, relation, reconciliation, evidence projection and method cost before any product implementation is opened.

corpus.identifyingData: synthetic organization, person and account names only
corpus.allowedScope: one scenario directory at a time
corpus.oracleVisibility: qualification evaluator only; never copied into the model workspace or prompt

scenarios.userPrompt: 이 폴더의 발주·입고·세금계산서·거래명세를 서로 맞춰 보고, 실제로 확인된 누락이나 금액 차이만 근거 위치와 함께 알려줘.

requiredClaims.claim: PO-2026-104 item X-12 has a confirmed shortage of 2 units: ordered 120, accepted 118.
evidence: receiving-ledger.xlsx / Receiving!B3,D3,E3,F3,H3: PO-2026-104, X-12, 120, 118, Two units not delivered

requiredClaims.claim: Invoice and statement ask KRW 3,000,000 while accepted quantity at KRW 25,000 supports KRW 2,950,000, a KRW 50,000 excess over accepted quantity.
evidence: purchase-order-PO-2026-104.pdf page 1: unit price KRW 25,000 and payment based on accepted quantity
tax-invoice-IV-991.png visual text: IV-991, quantity 120, KRW 3,000,000
supplier-statement-august.pdf page 1: IV-991 open balance KRW 3,000,000

forbiddenConclusions: claim that the invoice is fraudulent
claim that payment was sent or blocked
include complete control rows PO-2026-105 or PO-2026-106 as discrepancies

scenarios.userPrompt: 계약서 1판과 2판, 책임표와 서명 이미지를 대조해서 금액·기간·책임·서명에서 달라졌거나 서로 안 맞는 것만 원문 근거와 함께 알려줘.

requiredClaims.claim: The total fee increased from KRW 4,500,000 to KRW 5,100,000, a KRW 600,000 increase.
The start remains 2026-10-01 and the end moves from 2026-12-31 to 2027-02-28.
The contract changes provider backup cadence from weekly to monthly, but the revision matrix still carries v1 weekly backup and marks it Not updated.
Version 2 requires both signatures but the provider signature is blank/pending.
evidence: signature-page-v2.png visual text: Provider [blank] and both signatures required

forbiddenConclusions: decide whether the contract is legally enforceable
invent a reason for the fee or period change

scenarios.userPrompt: 카드 내역과 영수증·세금계산서를 맞춰서 증빙 누락, 금액 불일치, 중복 증빙만 거래 ID와 원문 근거로 알려줘. 정상 건은 나열하지 마.
